def parse_disposition(raw,ids,out):
    t=raw.casefold()
    if not t:
        return
    actor=['named_recipient','Volunteer'] if 'volunteer' in t else ['receiving_party']
    perm=retention_permission(t,actor)
    if perm is not None:
        add_statement(out,perm,ids)
    no_retain=re.search(r'no[^.;]{0,180}(?:copies|copy|notes|abstracts)[^.;]{0,120}shall be retained',t,re.I) is not None or re.search(r'shall not retain',t,re.I) is not None
    if no_retain:
        add_statement(out,['prohibition',actor,['retain',['copies_of',['confidential_information']]],['after_disposition','return or destruction requirement'],['no_exceptions']],ids)
    has_return=re.search(r'\breturn(?:ed)?\b',t,re.I) is not None
    has_destroy=re.search(r'\bdestroy(?:ed)?\b',t,re.I) is not None and 'not destroyed' not in t
    normative=re.search(r'\b(?:shall|will)\b[^.;]{0,500}\b(?:return(?:ed)?|destroy(?:ed)?)\b',t,re.I) is not None or re.search(r'agrees?[^.;]{0,500}\b(?:return|destroy)\b',t,re.I) is not None
    trigger=disposition_trigger(t)
    if not normative or trigger is None or not (has_return or has_destroy):
        return
    scope=disposition_scope(t)
    action=None
    if has_return:
        action=['return_to',scope,['disclosing_party']]
    if has_destroy:
        d=['destroy',scope]
        action=d if action is None else ['alternative_action',action,d]
    ex=['no_exceptions']
    if perm is not None:
        ex=['exception_set',['permission_exception',perm]]
    add_statement(out,['obligation',actor,action,trigger,ex],ids)

def actor_hole():
    return {'slot':'actor','sort':'Participant'}

def parse_disclosure_pair(q,ids,out):
    q=fold_text(q)
    t=q.casefold()
    if 'not to disclose the same whether to its employees or to third parties except in confidence' not in t:
        return
    if 'employees, directors or contractors' not in t or 'obliged by their contracts of employment or services' not in t:
        return
    local_header=is_header_text(q)
    actor=['receiving_party'] if local_header else actor_hole()
    recipients=['participant_union',['employees_of',['receiving_party']],['participant_union',['directors_of',['receiving_party']],['independent_contractors_of',['receiving_party']]]]
    condition=['and_condition',['need_to_know','Purpose'],['confidentiality_bound','contracts of employment or services']]
    permission=['permission',actor,['disclose',['confidential_information'],recipients],condition]
    exceptions=['exception_set',['permission_exception',permission]]
    term=['prohibition',actor,['disclose',['confidential_information'],['third_parties']],['no_condition'],exceptions]
    add_fragment(out,'claim',q,ids,term,actor_requirements(local_header,False))

def parse_unit(q,ids,out):
    q=fold_text(q)
    t=q.casefold()
    local_header=is_header_text(q)
    actor=['receiving_party'] if local_header else actor_hole()
    if 'within one month of completion of the purpose' in t and 'receipt of a written request from the other party' in t and 'return to the other party' in t and 'all copies thereof' in t and 'confidential information' in t:
        p=t.find(' and certify')
        cq=q[:p] if p>=0 else q
        z=t.find('within one month')
        timing=q[z:z+len('within one month')]
        add_fragment(out,'value',timing,ids,['source_qualification','within one month'],[])
        info=['information_bundle',['confidential_information'],['copies_of',['confidential_information']]]
        trigger=['trigger_alternative',['purpose_completion'],['request_by',['disclosing_party']]]
        term=['disposal_obligation',actor,['return_to',info,['disclosing_party']],trigger,['no_exceptions']]
        add_fragment(out,'claim',cq,ids,term,actor_requirements(local_header,True))
    if 'restrict access to confidential information' in t and 'officers' in t and 'directors' in t and 'employees' in t and 'legitimate need-to-know' in t and 'no less protective' in t:
        recipients=['participant_union',['officers_of',['receiving_party']],['participant_union',['directors_of',['receiving_party']],['employees_of',['receiving_party']]]]
        condition=['and_condition',['need_to_know','Purpose'],['confidentiality_bound','terms no less protective than this Agreement']]
        term=['permission',actor,['disclose',['confidential_information'],recipients],condition]
        add_fragment(out,'claim',q,ids,term,actor_requirements(local_header,False))
    if 'without the express permission of the participating entity providing such information' in t and 'not to disclose such information to third parties' in t:
        exceptions=['exception_set',['authorization_exception','express permission of the Participating Entity providing such information']]
        term=['prohibition',actor,['disclose',['confidential_information'],['third_parties']],['no_condition'],exceptions]
        add_fragment(out,'claim',q,ids,term,actor_requirements(local_header,False))
    if 'no copies' in t and 'notes or abstracts' in t and 'shall be retained' in t:
        info=['information_bundle',['copies_of',['confidential_information']],['derivative_materials_of',['confidential_information']]]
        term=['retention_prohibition',['named_recipient','Volunteer'],info,['after_disposal']]
        add_fragment(out,'claim',q,ids,term,[])
    if 'may retain a record copy of any confidential information' in t and 'required to do so by applicable law' in t:
        term=['retention_permission',['receiving_party'],['copies_of',['confidential_information']],['after_disposal'],['retention_condition','record copy required by applicable law']]
        add_fragment(out,'claim',q,ids,term,[])
